description: This file contains unit tests for various secret and credential classes in the org.eclipse.hono.service.management.credentials package. It tests encoding and decoding of different secret types, validation of date formats, and serialization/deserialization behavior.

classes.name: SecretsTest
classes.description: Contains unit tests verifying encoding, decoding, and date handling of secret and credential objects, including password, psk, and x509 credentials.

methods.name: testEncodePasswordSecret1
methods.description: Tests encoding of a simple password secret into JSON and verifies fields.

methods.name: testEncodePskSecret
methods.description: Tests encoding of a pre-shared key secret, verifying binary data and date fields.

methods.name: testEncodeX509Credential
methods.description: Tests encoding of an X509 credential object to JSON.

methods.name: testDecodeGeneric
methods.description: Tests decoding a generic credential with an unknown type and verifies properties.

methods.name: testDateFormats
methods.description: Ensures date fields are properly encoded and decoded, supporting timezone offsets.
